title: KEYS WINDOW CROUCH AND SPRINT ROWS CLAIM NO MODE
why: Found in the cloud hunt of 2026-10-15: the Keys window rows read SHIFT sprint (hold), CTRL crouch (hold) and C crouch toggle, but the CROUCH and SPRINT settings decide hold or toggle. Proven in headless Chromium on a fresh profile: crouchHold 0, a Ctrl tap crouched (true) and a second tap stood (false) while the row said crouch (hold); with CROUCH HOLD, C held instead while its row still said crouch toggle, and with SPRINT TOGGLE the SHIFT row still said hold. The rows now read sprint, crouch and crouch (second key). The pause legend is not touched (check v17.86 pins it).
now: The Keys window names sprint and crouch without claiming hold or toggle; the CROUCH and SPRINT settings decide that.
